scope: Claude Code targeted candidate-inference filesystem/auth boundary only

candidate_delta: Do not inherit host HOME or TMPDIR into targeted Claude inference.
Admit CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN as explicit script/CI authentication transport alongside existing Anthropic environment authentication.
Create one 0700 TemporaryDirectory per availability/reason subprocess and bind HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and TMPDIR beneath it.
Keep no-session, prompt-history, auto-memory, CLAUDE.md, tool-less and strict-MCP fences.
Pass empty --setting-sources so user/project/local filesystem settings are not an intended context source.
Delete the runtime roots automatically on normal return and timeout/exception unwinding.
primary_external_evidence: Claude Code authentication docs: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is a long-lived inference token intended for CI/scripts without browser login and takes precedence over cached login credentials.
Claude Code feature/settings docs: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR relocates Claude global config and empty setting sources are the isolation form; auto-memory requires a separate disable control.
Claude Code CLI docs: --no-session-persistence and --setting-sources are supported print/session controls.

Any such observation rejects promotion and must be retained as diagnostic FAIL.
